models.haar: Haar-random pure state on N qubits
models.stabilizer: random 2-qubit-Clifford brickwork of depth 6N applied to |0..0> (converges to the uniform random stabilizer state; depths N,2N,4N,6N recorded as a convergence check)
models.brick_D: Haar 2-qubit-gate brickwork of depth D on an open chain, from |0..0>
